items.title: Pictorial travel posters, 1949
items.description_narrative: These pictorial travel posters, created in 1949, represent a significant form of visual communication from the mid-20th century. Designed to entice viewers to explore new destinations, they often combined graphic design with photography to evoke a sense of adventure and wonder.
